name: KCC GLASS Corporation
summary: Based in South Korea, KCC Glass Corporation specializes in delivering advanced, specialized glass products. Its comprehensive offerings encompass glass for construction, automotive applications, and various coated finishes. Beyond glass, the company manufactures interior decorative items, flooring for buildings, vehicles, and marine vessels, alongside laminated interior films, vinyl-clad metallic goods, and artificial marble for interior design. KCC Glass Corporation was established in 2020, with its main offices situated in Seoul, South Korea.
